## Post-merge live verification

Recorded against a real Gateway built from `main` @ `aa35346a8ef`: isolated state dir and port, a simulated trusted proxy supplying a verified identity, and a paired device whose grant deliberately lacks `operator.admin`.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/184adddb-0770-4233-8ba6-d64a87de8c27

**What the clip shows**

The un-proxied connection — same Gateway, no verified identity, so no admin. The limited-access notice appears with a **Request admin** action; taking it files the upgrade request and shows the approval guidance (`openclaw devices` on the Gateway, or the Devices page on an admin browser) with Retry and Cancel. The point of the PR: the old dead-end tooltip is gone, and the action ends in a visible, actionable state.
